verdict: Events quantity + coverage (v2 extraction prompt, cue widening, partial-record header): 4 of 5 preregistered gates pass; the primary misses significance and per the ship rule nothing is promoted. Run A (deterministic quantity smoke) passed with every seeded quantity retained verbatim and v1 parity intact. Gate 1 (rag control vs aggserve-0806): exact zero over all 500 shared questions. Gate 2 (claims-inertness, noise-floor bound |delta| <= 0.01 and p > 0.05 per memory signal 426): measured EXACT zero (0/0 flips) - the claims prompt is byte-untouched and this run's extraction stream happened to reproduce bit-identically, so the within-run and cross-run comparisons are both clean. Gate 3 (primary, hybrid_ev_syn on the v2 bank vs the committed aggserve-0806 hybrid_ev_syn on multi-session, n=133): +0.038 (0.474 vs 0.436), p 0.226, 8W/3L - FAIL at the preregistered p < 0.05. The mechanism join is the informative part: 7 of the 8 win rows are exactly the audited residual rows the design targeted (cue-miss 2b8f3739/36b9f61e/6c49646a, quantity-not-representable bb7c3b45/cc06de0d/d905b33f, extraction-or-retrieval-gap c2ac3c61 - all amount-arithmetic, all needing quantities), i.e. the quantity rule converts precisely the rows it was written for, at roughly half the audit's ~15-row ceiling, while 3 losses (one a former syn-win on instance-count) plus binomial noise at n=133 keep the net +5 under the bar. Gate 4 (hybrid_ev_hdr no-harm, pooled all types): +0.002 vs same-run syn - PASS; the header arm is nominally the best arm of the run (0.720 overall) and posts the best temporal-reasoning cell of the series (0.662). Gate 5 (non-inferiority): temporal-reasoning +0.007 and the four strong types exactly zero (0/0 flips, n=234) - PASS both. The multi-session ladder under the v2 bank is hybrid 0.376 -> hybrid_ev 0.391 -> hybrid_ev_agg 0.459 -> hybrid_ev_syn 0.474 vs rag 0.504: widened serving + tally now recover ~77% of the hybrid-to-rag gap, up from ~47% under the v1 bank. Temporal reasoning replicates and extends: hybrid 0.526 -> hybrid_ev 0.647, header arm 0.662.

run_a.command: python evals/events_quantity_smoke.py --tag evq-0806 (v1 vs candidate v2 events prompt on synthetic quantity-bearing notes)
run_a.result: PASS - quantities missing: none; parity missing: none (v1 events: 7, candidate events: 8)

run.run_b_command: python evals/longmemeval_bench.py --dataset oracle --extractor qwen-27b --types all --chronicle --ev-variants --events-prompt-file evals/prompts/events_pass_v2.txt --tag evq-0806
run.design: Identical serving/variant construction to aggserve-0806 (hybrid_ev reconstructs the old gate; agg = full list on either cue; syn = agg + tally line) with two changes under test: the events extraction prompt is the v2 candidate (v1 + one keep-quantities/exhaustiveness rule) and has_aggregation_cue is widened (total <quantity-noun>, average, the most). hybrid_ev_hdr = syn content under a partial-record header, new this run.
run.judge: reproducible stock q8_0 llama-server via Start-Qwen (never -Fast)

gates.name: rag control (validity)
gates.prereg: rag vs aggserve-0806 rag, 500 shared questions, exactly 0 - rag never touches extraction so exact zero remains required

gates.name: claims-inertness (validity)
gates.prereg: vanilla hybrid vs aggserve-0806 hybrid, |delta| <= 0.01 AND p > 0.05 (noise-floor bound; the exact-zero cross-run bar was retired per memory signal 426 after failing twice on 2026-08-06 for a measured server-stream reason)
gates.result: PASS (exact zero - comfortably inside the bound; the claims prompt is byte-untouched and this run's extraction stream reproduced bit-identically)

gates.name: primary: hybrid_ev_syn (v2 bank) vs committed aggserve-0806 hybrid_ev_syn on multi-session
gates.prereg: improvement with p < 0.05, n=133, paired cross-run sign-flip permutation 10k/seed 0; the audit ceiling is ~15 reachable rows, >= 8 net conversions clears comfortably
gates.result: FAIL (direction-consistent, net +5 conversions, under the bar)

mechanism_join.reading: All 7 audited win rows are amount-arithmetic rows needing quantities - the exact mechanism classes the v2 rule and cue widening were written for. The prompt-level fix works where extraction reaches; it converted ~half the audited ceiling, and the shortfall is churn (3 losses) plus the still-unserved gap/partial rows, which are retrieval-side.

gates.name: header arm no-harm: hybrid_ev_hdr vs same-run hybrid_ev_syn, pooled all types
gates.prereg: no regression beyond 0.02 (reported + gating only against harm; its BEAM-facing win case is deferred to a BEAM re-run)
gates.result: PASS (no harm; nominally the best arm of the run at 0.720 overall and the best temporal-reasoning cell of the series at 0.662)

gates.name: non-inferiority: syn (v2 bank) vs same-run hybrid_ev on temporal-reasoning and the four strong types (margin 0.02 each)
gates.result: PASS (both; strong set exactly zero flips again)

decision: Not promoted (the ship rule requires gate 3 at p < 0.05 with gates 1-2 valid; gates 1-2 are valid, gate 3 fails). The shipped events extractor constant remains v1 (pinned by test); events_pass_v2.txt stays an unshipped candidate; the cue widening stays in the tree behind chronicle default-off, unblessed by measurement, same treatment as the aggserve serving change. Per the preregistered fail branch, the next probe is retrieval-side - chronicle_search matching on the gap rows (extraction-or-retrieval-gap 4, partial-block 2), measured, not assumed - because the mechanism join shows the prompt-level fix already converts the rows extraction reaches. Two subsidiary readings carry forward: (1) the hdr header is free (+0.002 pooled, best-of-run nominal cells) and its abstention-suppression win case should be measured on the next BEAM re-run before any production events_partial field is added; (2) v2 is non-inferior everywhere, exactly neutral on the strong four, and directionally better on multi-session, so its use as the teacher prompt for the events-pass distillation dataset (distill-events-opus1) stands.
